blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Police conducting a hot-pursuit operation against a suspected gunman linked to the shooting of a foreign national ended instead in the confiscation of P3.4 million worth of illegal cigarettes. This took place in Naga City in southern Cebu at past noon on October 7. The police chanced upon the boxes filled with reams of cigarettes piled on top of each other at the side of the house beside where they conducted the hot pursuit operation.
